title: Anthropic signs $10B deal with AI cloud startup Volta
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Anthropic has been on a cloud partnership spree in recent months, and its latest move is reportedly a $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta.
body:
Anthropic, a prominent AI research firm, has reportedly secured a significant $10 billion, six-year deal with AI cloud startup Volta. This strategic alliance is designed to substantially expand Anthropic's computational resources, crucial for the ongoing development and scaling of its advanced AI models, including Claude. To meet this demand, Volta is partnering with Bitdeer, a crypto-mining company, to construct a dedicated 133-megawatt data center in Norway, ensuring a robust and long-term supply of compute power.

The technological backbone of this expansive infrastructure will be Nvidia's cutting-edge Vera Rubin systems, leveraging Volta's position within Nvidia's Cloud Partner program. This collaboration guarantees Anthropic access to state-of-the-art GPU technology, providing the immense processing capabilities essential for training increasingly complex large language models and fostering future AI breakthroughs. This move highlights the critical importance of securing dedicated, high-performance compute resources in today's fiercely competitive AI landscape.

For developers and researchers, this agreement underscores the intense "compute race" currently defining the AI industry. It signals Anthropic's proactive approach to acquiring the foundational infrastructure needed to push the boundaries of AI capabilities, ensuring they can continue to deliver more powerful and sophisticated models. Such substantial, long-term compute commitments are vital for sustained research and development, enabling the breakthroughs that will ultimately benefit the broader AI ecosystem by providing more advanced tools and platforms for innovation.
